art_direction: 蜜璃双辫与粉绿发色搭配端整开衫，奶油水粉背景和万花筒眼保持明朗温柔。
composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Paint Mitsuri Kanroji with her recognizable pink hair fading into green and two braids resting over a fully buttoned cream cardigan. Use a modest high-neck blouse beneath it and natural adult proportions. She lightly holds the cardigan edges low near her waist, while looking toward the viewer with a warm closed-mouth smile. Use soft opaque gouache, broad cream background space, and small sage accents that complement the braids. Keep the eyes clear beneath the bangs and the face expressive without exaggerated blush. The braid shapes form a balanced frame around the centered head and shoulders. Inside both visible irises, place a red Mangekyo-inspired design using an original simple rotating black petal pattern, a clear pupil, and bright catchlights; the marks stay entirely inside the irises. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
